title: Gemini cli bot marks issue as stale and closes it in the same minute

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear report with an example of the bot marking an issue as stale and closing it in the same minute, pointing directly to the lifecycle management workflow behavior.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix requires localized logic changes in a single GitHub workflow script (.github/scripts/gemini-lifecycle-manager.cjs) to prevent processing newly stale issues in Step 3 during the same script run.

summary.problem: The Gemini CLI lifecycle management bot marks an issue as stale and closes it within the same minute.
summary.root_cause: In .github/scripts/gemini-lifecycle-manager.cjs, Step 2 adds the stale label to inactive issues, and Step 3 immediately processes stale issues in the same script run. If an issue had a prior stale label event or if timeline event indexing is delayed/missing, Step 3 evaluates the stale issue against an old timestamp or fails to detect that it was newly labeled in the current run, closing it prematurely.
summary.context: Issues marked as stale should remain open for a 14-day grace period (CLOSE_DAYS) before being automatically closed.

steps: Track issues that were marked as stale in Step 2 during the current execution run.
In Step 3, skip closure evaluation for any issue that was marked stale during the current run.
Ensure the stale event lookup verifies that the stale label addition timestamp is older than CLOSE_DAYS (14 days) before attempting to close the issue.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When an issue is marked as stale, it will not be closed in the same execution run and will remain open for at least 14 days before closure.
verification_steps: Run the gemini-lifecycle-manager script in DRY_RUN mode on candidate issues.
Verify that Step 3 does not schedule closure for issues newly marked stale in Step 2.
